Serverless API Terraform Workload - File Summary
================================================

Created: 2025-12-22
Purpose: Production-realistic Terraform configuration with embedded security flaws for testing

TERRAFORM FILES (10):
- main.tf                 Provider config, data sources
- variables.tf            Input variables with defaults
- outputs.tf              Output values for API and resources
- api-gateway.tf          REST API, resources, methods, integrations, stage
- lambda.tf               5 Lambda functions with CloudWatch logs
- dynamodb.tf             DynamoDB table with GSIs, streams, alarms
- cognito.tf              User Pool, App Client, Identity Pool
- iam.tf                  Lambda execution role and policies
- waf.tf                  WAF Web ACL with managed rules
- (No backend.tf - local state)

LAMBDA FUNCTIONS (5):
- lambda_functions/create_item.js    POST /items
- lambda_functions/get_item.js       GET /items/{id}
- lambda_functions/list_item.js      GET /items
- lambda_functions/update_item.js    PUT /items/{id}
- lambda_functions/delete_item.js    DELETE /items/{id}

DOCUMENTATION (2):
- README.md               Complete architecture and usage documentation
- SECURITY_FLAWS.md       Detailed list of 5 embedded security issues

ARCHITECTURE COMPONENTS:
✓ API Gateway REST API (regional)
✓ 5 Lambda functions (Node.js 18.x)
✓ DynamoDB table with 3 GSIs
✓ Cognito User Pool + Identity Pool
✓ WAF Web ACL with 5 rules
✓ CloudWatch Logs (Lambda, WAF)
✓ X-Ray tracing
✓ IAM roles and policies
✓ CloudWatch alarms (DynamoDB, WAF)

EMBEDDED SECURITY FLAWS (5):
1. CRITICAL - Lambda IAM role with dynamodb:* wildcard permissions
2. HIGH     - DynamoDB table without customer-managed KMS encryption
3. MEDIUM   - API Gateway stage without access logging
4. HIGH     - Cognito User Pool without MFA enforcement (mfa_configuration = "OFF")
5. CRITICAL - Lambda environment variables with hardcoded secrets (DB_PASSWORD, API_KEY)

TERRAFORM VERSION: >= 1.5.0
AWS PROVIDER: ~> 5.0
ARCHIVE PROVIDER: ~> 2.4

VALIDATION STATUS:
- Syntax: Valid Terraform 1.5+ syntax
- Deployability: Fully deployable (requires AWS credentials)
- Lambda Code: Working Node.js code with proper error handling
- Security Flaws: Intentionally embedded for testing purposes

EXPECTED SCAN RESULTS:
When scanned with Prowler/Checkov/InfraBot, expect:
- 2 CRITICAL findings (IAM wildcards, hardcoded secrets)
- 2 HIGH findings (DynamoDB encryption, Cognito MFA)
- 1 MEDIUM finding (API Gateway logging)
